info.title: Desyn Agent API
info.description:
The Desyn Agent API lets agents and scripts do what the editor does: create and read designs, commit transactions, render previews, export, upload assets, use templates and brand kits, and run the AI.

**Authentication.** Send an API key as `Authorization: Bearer dsk_…` (or `x-api-key`). A key acts as the member who created it, in the workspace it was created for, limited to its scopes. Write scopes only apply while the member has at least the editor role.

**Errors.** Failures return `{ "error": { "code", "message", … } }` with a stable code:

| Status | Code |
| --- | --- |
| 401 | `UNAUTHENTICATED` |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` |
| 400 | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` |
| 409 | `CONFLICT` |
| 410 | `EXPIRED` |
| 422 | `LIMIT_REACHED` |
| 403 | `FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE` |
| 429 | `RATE_LIMITED` |
| 403 | `BILLING_DISABLED` |
| 501 | `NOT_CONFIGURED` |
| 403 | `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` |
| 500 | `INTERNAL` |
| 403 | `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` |
| 405 | `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` |
| 413 | `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` |
| 415 | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` |
| 422 | `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` |
| 409 | `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` |
| 503 | `UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE` |

**Pagination.** List endpoints take `limit` and `cursor` and return `nextCursor` (null on the last page).

**Idempotency.** POST endpoints marked idempotent accept an `Idempotency-Key` header (1-255 printable characters). A retry with the same key and body returns the stored response (`idempotent-replayed: true`); the same key with a different body is rejected with `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`. Keys are kept for 24 hours. Transactions are also idempotent on `tx.id`.

**Rate limits.** Each key has a token bucket (see `GET /usage` → `api`); heavier endpoints cost more tokens. Over the limit the API answers 429 with `Retry-After` (seconds) and `retryAfterMs`. AI endpoints additionally follow the account's fair-use caps and credits.

get.description: The member the API key acts as, its plan, workspace, role and effective scopes.
Workspaces the member belongs to. API calls are always scoped to the key's own workspace (`current`).
AI credits for the current period: grant, used, reserved by running jobs, overage (never billed) and whether requests are soft-throttled. `granted` / `remaining` are null when unlimited.
Usage counters against the plan limits, credits, fair-use caps and the key's API rate limit.

Designs of the key's workspace, most recently updated first.

Required scopes: `designs:read`.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Only designs in this folder; "root" for designs outside folders.

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: Only designs the key's member created.

post.description:
Creates a design from a page preset, a custom size or a template. To have the AI build it, create it and start an agent run.

Required scopes: `designs:write`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored for 24 hours and replayed.

get.description:
Metadata of one design. Load the document for its content.

Required scopes: `designs:read`.

patch.description:
Change the name (committed through the transaction log, so open editors update live) and/or the folder.

Required scopes: `designs:write`.

delete.description:
Moves the design to the trash (purged after 30 days). With `permanent=true` on a design that is already in the trash, deletes it with its history now.

Required scopes: `designs:write`.

parameters.name: permanent
parameters.description: Permanently delete a design that is already in the trash. Default: move to the trash.

post.description:
Hides an active design from lists without deleting it.

Required scopes: `designs:write`.

Restores an archived or trashed design.

Required scopes: `designs:write`.

get.description:
The full `Design` (DOCUMENT_MODEL.md) and the seq it reflects. Asset `url`s are filled with signed URLs; never commit them back.

Required scopes: `designs:read`.

post.description:
Applies ops to the current server state (last writer wins per property). Ops that no longer apply are dropped and reported, never fatal. Idempotent on `tx.id`; with an `Idempotency-Key` header and no `tx.id`, the id is derived from the key.

Required scopes: `designs:write`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored for 24 hours and replayed.

get.description:
Accepted transactions after `since`, oldest first. Poll it to follow a design. When `reload` is true the log was compacted: load the document again.

Required scopes: `designs:read`.

The semantic description the AI reads (DOCUMENT_MODEL §7): tree in page coordinates, palette, fonts, typography, grid, hierarchy and lint issues. Computed by the render worker.

Required scopes: `designs:read`.

post.description:
Renders one page (or a region) synchronously through the render worker and returns the image bytes. The `x-desyn-seq` header names the seq rendered. Use exports for print-quality files.

Required scopes: `designs:read`.

Maps the design's colors, fonts and logos onto a brand kit without moving the layout, repairs text contrast and commits the result as one transaction.

Required scopes: `designs:write`, `brand:read`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored for 24 hours and replayed.

post.description:
Queues an export job on the render worker. Poll the export until `status` is `ready`. Formats are plan features (`export.*`).

Required scopes: `exports:write`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored for 24 hours and replayed.

get.description:
Status of an export job, with signed download URLs once ready.

Required scopes: `exports:write`.

Ready assets of the workspace, newest first.

Required scopes: `assets:read`.

post.description:
Validates type and size against the plan and returns a presigned PUT URL. Upload the bytes with exactly the returned headers within 15 minutes, then finalize.

Required scopes: `assets:write`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored for 24 hours and replayed.

post.description:
Verifies the uploaded object (size, type, magic bytes), reads dimensions, sanitizes SVG and dedupes. Returns the (possibly deduplicated) asset.

Required scopes: `assets:write`.

get.description:
Metadata, a signed GET URL and a ready-made AssetRef.

Required scopes: `assets:read`.

patch.description:
Change the display name in the library.

Required scopes: `assets:write`.

delete.description:
Removes it from the library. Designs that use it keep working; the bytes go once nothing references them.

Required scopes: `assets:write`.

get.description:
Full-text search (`q`) or browse by kind / category. Premium templates need Pro to instantiate.

Required scopes: `templates:read`.

Template metadata including its slots (layers meant to be replaced).

Required scopes: `templates:read`.

post.description:
Creates a design from the template with fresh ids, optionally fills slots (text, or images by asset) and applies a brand kit.

Required scopes: `designs:write`, `templates:read`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored for 24 hours and replayed.

get.description:
Brand kits of the workspace (the default kit first).

Required scopes: `brand:read`.

post.description:
Requires the `brandKit` feature and counts toward the `brandKits` limit.

Required scopes: `brand:write`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored for 24 hours and replayed.

get.description:
One brand kit with signed logo / font URLs.

Required scopes: `brand:read`.

patch.description:
Replace any field. Designs that follow the kit are not changed until the kit is applied again.

Required scopes: `brand:write`.

delete.description:
Designs keep their current styling.

Required scopes: `brand:write`.

get.description:
Folders of the workspace as a flat list with `parentId`.

Required scopes: `designs:read`.

post.description:
Starts the server-side agent on a design: it reads the design, plans, edits through transactions (`source: "ai"`, one undo group) and finishes with a summary. Credits are reserved up front and settled when the run ends; AI fair-use caps apply.

Required scopes: `ai:run`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored for 24 hours and replayed.

get.description:
Status, pending question, credits and the result of an agent or asset run.

Required scopes: `ai:run`.

Events of a run after a cursor. With `Accept: text/event-stream` the response is a Server-Sent Events stream (`id` = event index, resume with `Last-Event-ID`) that ends with a `stream-end` event when the run finishes, or after about a minute without one (reconnect with `Last-Event-ID`); a failure while streaming is a `stream-error` event with `{ code, message }`. Every other event name is the AgentEvent `type`, including a run's own `error` events; otherwise JSON, optionally long-polling with `wait`.

Required scopes: `ai:run`.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Long-poll: wait up to this many seconds for new events. Default 0.

200.description: Run events (JSON page, or an SSE stream of AiRunEvent).

post.description:
Resumes a run that paused with a question (status needs-input).

Required scopes: `ai:run`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored for 24 hours and replayed.

post.description:
Stops the run after the current step. Committed edits stay (undo them as one step); unused reserved credits are returned.

Required scopes: `ai:run`.

Runs one asset tool (image, svg, remove-background, inpaint, outpaint, upscale, mockup, trace) as a run; when it completes, `result.assetId` / `result.refId` name the new asset (`source: "ai"`).

Required scopes: `ai:run`, `assets:write`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored for 24 hours and replayed.

post.description:
Starts a durable multi-step workflow: campaign, variants, resize, localize, bulk or exportBundle. Each step bills credits as it completes; outputs are new designs.

Required scopes: `ai:run`, `designs:write`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored for 24 hours and replayed.

get.description:
Progress and outputs of a workflow run.

Required scopes: `ai:run`.

Models available to the member per AI task (live provider catalogs, BYOK keys and local endpoints) with the routing default marked.

Required scopes: `ai:run`.

burst.description: Requests that can be made at once.

colors.description: Map colors onto the palette. Default true.

fonts.description: Map fonts onto the kit fonts. Default true.

commit.description: null when nothing had to change.

pages.description: "all" (default) or page ids in output order.

notify.description: Email the member when ready (default: large jobs only).

url.description: Signed GET URL (never persist it in a design).

bearerAuth.description: API key from Settings → API keys. Scopes: `designs:read` (List and read designs, documents and transactions; describe and preview pages; list folders.); `designs:write` (Create, rename, archive and delete designs; commit transactions; instantiate templates; apply brand kits.); `assets:read` (List assets and get signed URLs.); `assets:write` (Upload, rename and delete assets.); `templates:read` (Search and read templates.); `brand:read` (Read brand kits.); `brand:write` (Create, change and delete brand kits.); `ai:run` (Start and control agent runs, asset generation and workflows, and list models. Spends credits on the hosted plan.); `exports:write` (Request exports and read their status.); `mcp` (Connect to the MCP server (requires the MCP feature: Pro or self-hosted).)
